# listmonk_list (Resource)

Manages a listmonk mailing list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "listmonk_list" "newsletter" {
  name        = "Newsletter"
  type        = "public"
  optin       = "double"
  tags        = ["newsletter", "marketing"]
  description = "Monthly product newsletter"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the list.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the list. listmonk cannot clear a description once set, so removing this argument keeps the current description.
- `optin` (String) `single` subscribes immediately; `double` sends a confirmation e-mail first. Defaults to `single`.
- `status` (String) `active` or `archived`. Defaults to `active`. Archiving requires listmonk v6 or later.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags on the list. Tags cannot contain whitespace (listmonk would rewrite it to `-`).
- `type` (String) `public` lists are shown on the public subscription page; `private` lists are not. Defaults to `private`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the list.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the list.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Lists are imported by their numeric ID.
terraform import listmonk_list.newsletter 3
```
